title: "Installation"

{/* Generated from docs/templates/mcp/installation.mdx — do not edit directly. */}

The server runs locally via `npx` and talks to the Calibrate
[public API](/api-reference/introduction). You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org)
20+ and a Calibrate API key — create one under
[**Workspace settings → API keys**](https://calibrate.artpark.ai/workspace-settings?tab=api-keys).

## Config file locations

For clients that use a JSON config file (Claude Desktop), it lives here:

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="macOS">
    ```
    ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Windows">
    ```
    %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Linux">
    ```
    ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Connect your client

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    claude mcp add calibrate -- npx -y @dalmia/calibrate-mcp start --api-key-auth sk_your_api_key
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    Add to your MCP settings (`stdio` transport):

    ```json
    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "calibrate": {
          "command": "npx",
          "args": ["-y", "@dalmia/calibrate-mcp", "start"],
          "env": {
            "CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH": "sk_your_api_key"
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Desktop">
    Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` (see paths above):

    ```json
    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "calibrate": {
          "command": "npx",
          "args": ["-y", "@dalmia/calibrate-mcp", "start"],
          "env": {
            "CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH": "sk_your_api_key"
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Warning>
  Fully quit and reopen your client after editing its config — Claude Desktop
  needs a complete restart, not just a new window.
</Warning>

## Environment variables

| Variable | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH` | Yes | Your Calibrate API key. Equivalent to the `--api-key-auth` flag. |
| `CALIBRATE_DEBUG` | No | Set to `true` for verbose logging. |

For self-hosted Calibrate deployments, pass `--server-url` to point the server
at your API instance:

```bash
npx -y @dalmia/calibrate-mcp start \
  --api-key-auth "$CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH" \
  --server-url https://calibrate.my-company.internal
```

## Local development

To run from a local clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dalmia/calibrate-mcp
cd calibrate-mcp
npm install
npm run build
node bin/mcp-server.js start --api-key-auth sk_your_api_key
```

Inspect the tools interactively with the
[MCP Inspector](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/tools/inspector):

```bash
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node bin/mcp-server.js start
```

Point your client at the local build by using `node` with the path to
`bin/mcp-server.js` instead of `npx @dalmia/calibrate-mcp`.
